finalText:
**Migration done in 12 files.** All 36 `db.query` calls now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `node --check` passes on every file.

Two calls stay on `db.query`, both in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit. Upgrade the package or drop the vendored copy.

`cache.query` is a different API. I left it alone.
